App.Title: UEBulkExport
App.Tagline: Bulk export for Unreal Engine containers
Export.Title: Export
Export.Subtitle: Point at a game, choose where the result goes, press Start.
Export.Source.Title: 1 · Source
Export.Source.Subtitle: The game whose containers you want to extract.
Export.Paks.Label: Game or Paks folder
Export.Paks.Hint: The game's root folder works: the Paks folder is found inside it. You can also drop a folder or a container file onto this window.
Export.Game.Label: Engine version
Export.Game.Hint: The Unreal Engine version the game was built with. Check the game's .uproject or its executable properties when unsure.
Export.Aes.Label: AES keys
Export.Aes.Placeholder: 0x0123…CDEF — one per line; use <guid>:0x… to bind a key to one container
Export.Aes.Hint: Only for encrypted containers. Leave empty otherwise.
Export.Scan.Locked: {0} container(s) locked — wrong or missing AES key
Export.Scan.Hint: Optional: mounts the containers to check the key and fill the Browser tab.
Export.Output.Title: 2 · Destination and mode
Export.Output.Subtitle: Where the files go and what shape they take.
Export.Out.Label: Output folder
Export.Out.Hint: The container's directory tree is mirrored inside it. Re-running into the same folder resumes an interrupted export.
Export.Mode.Label: Mode
Mode.Legacy.Title: Cooked packages
Mode.Legacy.Desc: Extract .uasset / .umap with their payloads. IoStore packages are converted to the classic cooked layout with retoc. No mappings file needed.
Mode.Full.Title: Convert assets
Mode.Full.Desc: Parse every package and write textures as PNG, meshes as glTF, animations, sounds, levels and JSON property dumps. Needs a .usmap for UE5 games.
Mode.Json.Title: JSON only
Mode.Json.Desc: Property dumps only. Fast, small, ideal for comparing two builds. Needs a .usmap for UE5 games.
Mode.Raw.Title: Raw dump
Mode.Raw.Desc: Byte-exact copy of every container entry. No parsing, no mappings. IoStore packages stay in Zen layout.
Export.Usmap.Label: Mappings (.usmap)
Export.Usmap.Placeholder: auto-detected when a single .usmap sits next to the executable or the containers
Export.Usmap.Hint: Shipping UE5 builds store properties without names; a .usmap restores them. See About → Mappings guide for how to generate one in two minutes.
Export.Usmap.Required: This mode needs a mappings file for UE5 games.
Export.Options.Title: 3 · Options
Export.Options.Subtitle: Sensible defaults. Expand only if you need something specific.
Export.Filters.Title: Filters
Export.Filters.Hint: Matched against the container path, e.g. ^Engine/ to drop stock engine content. Pick folders in the Browser tab to fill these in.
Export.Filters.LegacyIoStore: Filters are not available for IoStore games in Cooked packages mode: retoc converts the whole container.
Export.What.Title: What to write
Export.Formats.Title: Formats
Export.Formats.Hint: Only used by Convert assets mode.
Opt.NoWorlds.Hint: Levels are written as USD and pull in a copy of every mesh they reference. Large.
Opt.Materials.Hint: Meshes pull in their materials and textures. Slower; resume with 1 thread if it stalls.
Opt.NoAudioConvert: Do not convert BINKA / ADPCM audio to .wav
Opt.Overwrite.Hint: By default a second run into the same folder only does what is missing.
Export.Tools.Title: 4 · Helper binaries
Export.Tools.Subtitle: Found or downloaded automatically. Set a path only to use your own copy.
Tools.Retoc.Hint: Converts IoStore packages to the cooked layout. A verified copy is downloaded on Windows x64.
Tools.Vgmstream.Hint: Turns BINKA / ADPCM audio into .wav. Never downloaded; supply it yourself.
Convert.Title: 5 · Migrate assets between Unreal Engine versions
Convert.Subtitle: Export recoverable cooked assets through UE Viewer, then rebuild them with the target Unreal Editor.
Convert.AutoDetect.Hint: Finds UE Viewer and the Unreal Editor matching the project, and suggests a recently used project if none is set. The project is never chosen for you at startup; check every path before you start.
Convert.Confirm.Title: Import into this project?
Convert.AutoDetect.Searching: Searching for UE Viewer, an Unreal project and the matching editor…
Convert.AutoDetect.Result: Automatic search: UE Viewer — {0}; project — {1}; Unreal Editor — {2}.
Convert.Limitations: Cooking permanently removes editor-only data. Meshes, textures and supported audio can be rebuilt; Blueprint graphs, maps, Niagara graphs and other editor-only data cannot. UE5 does not natively import UE Viewer's .psa animations.
Convert.Source.Label: Source dump folder
Convert.Source.Placeholder: D:\Dump — a folder containing cooked .uasset files
Convert.Source.Hint: A loose cooked dump is accepted. If it already contains glTF, FBX, images or audio, those files are imported directly.
Convert.SourceVersion.Label: Source engine version
Convert.SourceVersion.Hint: UE Viewer supports UE4.0–4.27 sources in this workflow.
Convert.TargetVersion.Label: Detected target version
Convert.TargetVersion.Hint: Read from the .uproject file or the Unreal Editor path.
Convert.UModel.Label: UE Viewer (umodel_64.exe)
Convert.Project.Label: Target project (.uproject)
Convert.Editor.Label: Target UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe
Convert.Destination.Label: Content destination
Convert.Destination.Hint: Unreal virtual path; it must start with /Game.
Convert.Overwrite.Hint: Off is safer and lets an interrupted conversion resume.

Convert.Stage.Exporting: UE Viewer is exporting cooked assets…

About.Title: About
About.Subtitle: What this is, what it is built on, and what it is not.
About.Description: UEBulkExport extracts an entire Unreal Engine container — every .pak, .utoc and .ucas — into one folder, mirroring the game's directory tree. It is the “take everything” button that asset browsers deliberately leave out.
About.BuiltOn.Text: Container reading and asset conversion are done by CUE4Parse and CUE4Parse-Conversion (Apache-2.0). IoStore packages are converted to the cooked layout by retoc (MIT). UEBulkExport is the orchestration on top: discovery, scheduling, resumable runs, diagnostics and this window.
About.NotUncooker: This is not an uncooker. Cooking removes editor-only data; extracted packages are the cooked originals, not editable source assets. Blueprint graphs cannot be recovered.
About.License.Text: Apache License 2.0. Third-party components and their licenses are listed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
About.Legal.Text: This tool reads files you already have. It does not circumvent DRM or break encryption — any AES key is supplied by you.
